description: This file defines the ReturnAction model class for managing return actions within the Opencart admin localization module. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving return action records from the database, as well as handling associated descriptions and caching.

classes.name: ReturnAction
classes.description: Model class for managing return actions, including CRUD operations and descriptions, within the Opencart admin localization module.

methods.name: addReturnAction
methods.description: Creates a new return action record in the database, inserting data for multiple languages and returning the new return action ID.

methods.name: editReturnAction
methods.description: Edits an existing return action by deleting previous records and inserting new descriptions for all specified languages.

methods.name: deleteReturnAction
methods.description: Deletes a return action record by its ID from the database.

methods.name: deleteReturnActionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return actions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getReturnAction
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return action record based on its ID, considering the current language.

methods.name: getReturnActions
methods.description: Fetches a list of return actions with optional filters, sorting, pagination, and caching.

methods.name: getTotalReturnActions
methods.description: Returns the total number of return action records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a localization description for a return action for a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return action descriptions associated with a particular language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description details for a specific return action and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a given return action ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions associated with a specific language ID.
